findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Alternative mitigation accepted: the declared-permission check runs on every request through Requires.__call__, denials return a uniform opaque 403 while the audit log records identity, role and attempted action; the Spring-specific .anyRequest().denyAll() construct named in the countermeasure has no FastAPI analogue, and its security property is met by the deny-by-default permission table plus the per-route dependency | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Alternative mitigation accepted: AuthzContext.require/require_ownership authorize against the server-derived actor and the database-loaded resource rather than client-asserted ids, and owned_by() narrows the query itself so a handler that forgets the check never holds another user's row | verdict=pass confidence=high
